description: A line comment on its own line between attributes is ignored
notes: A line comment is equivalent to a newline, and the Body production (Attribute | Block | OneLineBlock)* has no place for a newline that doesn't end an item. hashicorp/hcl turns the comment into a newline token (peeker.nextToken in hclsyntax/peeker.go) and skips newline tokens wherever a body item may start: before the first item, between items, after the last one and in a body with no items (parser.ParseBody in hclsyntax/parser.go).
